operation.description: What to do; structure when left out

range.description: For read: what to return, in the format's addresses

pages.description: PDF pages to read, or pages to render, such as "3", "1-5" or "1,3,7-9"

query.description: For search: the text to find

limit.description: For read and search: items to return

use_engine.description: For check: also use LibreOffice if available

text_only.description: For render: no images, just the rendered pages' text

run_outside_sandbox.description: Ask the user to run LibreOffice outside the OS sandbox. Only after a render or engine check said it needs that

description.description: A short label of what this call works on or looks for, shown to the user as its row: a noun phrase of 2 to 6 words, no leading verb
